_comment: Vertical-stack region 3 of 3: the disc of Limbo, the First Circle. Owns the limbo terrain region (disc heightmap + ceiling + rock-collar walls) + the Acheron trench modifier. Static meshes: the Acheron pile (near shore) + the Castle foundation base (back-left corner, first Castle geometry piece per docs/design/limbo.md). Return-trigger fires when player walks back into the descent corridor mouth (heading north toward Z > -346.85).

static_meshes._comment: Acheron pile -- the centuries-old dissolved-soul-substance heap at the embarkation point. Per [[project_soul_larvae_cosmology]] LOCKED 2026-06-04: soul substance that has lost the integrity to hold any coherent arrangement; imprint persists, sangue still there, but soul-form has dispersed. Also the cosmological mechanism by which new fresh larvae appear -- they re-coalesce out of this substance because Hell's broken delivery still requires souls to materialize at the embarkation point and uses the pile's substrate to do so. Positioned at the spawn_position from config/spawn_flows/acheron_larvae.json. Generated by scripts/blender/gen_acheron_pile.py. Player-facing strings (the '[E] Examine' prompt noun + the examine prose body) are tier-gated through config/lang/world.json.

Castle foundation -- 89m x 89m x 15m Roman masonry block with the doorway + vestibule + helical ramp corridor bored through it as one solid. Reference Castel Sant'Angelo (Hadrian's Mausoleum), 1:1 scale. Placement per docs/design/limbo.md: back-left corner of Limbo from the descent stairs facing in, adjacent to the field where the honored pagan souls stand around the fire. Bottom sits at Limbo floor level; full 15m above ground per historical mass. Subsequent authoring passes add the cylindrical drum (64m x 21m), further chambers, medieval + Renaissance layers on top. Generated by scripts/blender/gen_castle_foundation.py.

terrain_modifiers._comment: Acheron + castle moat as ONE concave polygon. The E-W Acheron main channel (Z=[-391,-379], X=[-170,+170]) branches south via a 12m channel (X=[-152,-140]) that terminates at the castle's moat. The moat half-wraps the castle on its compass-north and compass-east faces (an L-shape hugging the NE corner) -- historically accurate to Castel Sant'Angelo where the Tiber only bends around part of the mausoleum. Inner moat edges TOUCH the castle outer wall (Z=-607.5 on north, X=-101.5 on east) with sharp blend pad so terrain doesn't ramp into the castle foundation. Outer moat + Acheron banks use soft 5m pads for natural shorelines. Disc-rim E/W edges of Acheron sharp (0m) so they clip against the disc boundary. Vertices CCW-wound starting at Acheron SW. Water surface Y = -47.13 (4m below Limbo floor at -43.13).

triggers._comment: Player walks back into the descent corridor mouth from Limbo, heading north (toward Z=-346 then up the stairs). Mirrors chapel_interior's limbo_descent_enter trigger.

doors._comment: Interactive door in the east wall of the miniboss corridor past the drum's compass-south doorway. Corridor east wall at Blender X=-8.25 with a 1m-wide gap centered at Y=+23 (door_hw=0.5). Hinge at the -Y edge of the gap (Blender X=-8.25, Y=+22.5, Z=15) so the door swings inward into the corridor when opened. Yaw=pi/2 rotates the mesh so its 1m X-extent lies along world -Z (Blender +Y), filling the gap. Placeholder chapel_door mesh until a castle-specific door is authored.

hazard_zones._comment: Acheron danger zone (broader than the literal water). Damned-soul archetypes with avoids_hazards including 'acheron' will not chase the player into this zone; locomotion velocity clamps at the boundary. North edge at Z=-372 sits just south of the larva slot row (~Z=-371), so the queue stays put while the player is anywhere south of them. Y half-extent is intentionally LARGE (50m) so the zone catches actors regardless of their Y -- a previous tight Y bound (2m) let actors standing slightly above the trench top register as 'outside,' bypassing the clamp. Cosmologically: Acheron's substance-disrupting effect bleeds outward from the literal water -- damned souls won't approach the bank because the dissolution radius extends past it. Per [[project_soul_larvae_cosmology]] river-dissolves-on-contact + setting.md sangue substance law.

_enemy_spawns_note: Shade encounter layout per [[project_acheron_river_lore]] + the canonical Limbo doctrine. All shades sit SOUTH of the Acheron trench (Z < -385) -- they're the human-gone-mad inhabitants who were on the far shore BEFORE the throughput stopped. The near-shore side will eventually carry the soul 'larvae' piling on the riverbank waiting for the absent ferry (separate system, TBD). Each light cluster from registerLimboLights gets a pair of shades flanking the light, both facing north (yaw=0 = -Z, the direction the player crosses Acheron from) -- they read as the dying-inhabitants' guards watching the river approach. 16 shades total across 8 light clusters. All Y=-43.13 (Limbo floor); tickEnemyLocomotion snaps to ground each frame.
_comment_larvae_removed: Phase 4 hand-placed larva test spawns removed in Phase 5. The general spawn-flow system (config/spawn_flows/acheron_larvae.json + src/spawn/FlowSpawner.cpp) is the canonical source of larvae populations now.

enemy_spawns._comment: Cluster 1 (limbo_campfire_a at -40,-560): 4m west of fire, facing north toward Acheron.
Cluster 1 (limbo_campfire_a): 4m east flank, watching the same approach.
Cluster 3 (limbo_fungus_a at -90,-700): west flank of the fungus bowl gathering.
Cluster 4 (limbo_fungus_b at 120,-650): far east of the lit field, west flank of bowl.
Cluster 5 (limbo_brazier_a at 80,-740): bright warm brazier, west flank.
Cluster 6 (limbo_brazier_b at 0,-780): brightest light in Limbo (intensity 1.0, radius 16). Central pair, west flank.
Cluster 6 (limbo_brazier_b): east flank of the central brazier.
Cluster 7 (limbo_campfire_c at -130,-820): deep south-west, west flank.
Cluster 8 (limbo_fungus_c at 30,-870): southernmost cluster, ~250m south of Acheron. West flank.
Cluster 8 (limbo_fungus_c): east flank, deepest into Limbo. Reward encounter for full exploration.

_props_note: Light vignettes on Limbo's far shore. Migrated 2026-06-09 from PhysicsRegion.cpp::registerLimboLights to the PropArchetype pipeline. Two cosmological archetypes (limbo_warm_light for campfires/braziers/oil lamps; limbo_fungus_light for bioluminescent fungus); per-decl light_intensity / light_range overrides handle the main + companion size variation without proliferating archetype files. All Y = -43.13 (Limbo floor) + 0.8 (waist height) = -42.33. Eight encampments, each a main+companion pair = 16 instances. Layout matches the legacy registerLimboLights call exactly.
_territory_note: Single territory volume covering the entire Limbo disc. Centered at the disc center (0, ?, -621.15), extents 300m radius approximated as a 320m XZ AABB (overshoots into void at corners but the void claims no other region, so position queries near the rim return 'limbo' correctly). Y range covers the disc floor at -43.13 down a few meters (in case actors are ever knocked-down below) and up to the ceiling at Y=-7. Priority 0; chapel_interior's descent corridor volume sits at priority 0 too but is much smaller (~4600 m^3 vs limbo's ~3 million m^3) so smallest-wins gives chapel_interior the corridor positions and limbo gets the rest.

territory._comment: Limbo disc territory. Conservative AABB approximation of the 300m-radius disc, Y range covers floor + below to ceiling.
